Leonard,

Done. "Q4 update - send list" is in my Q4 2025 investor update folder (Google Sheet, shared with you). It covers the bridge round as of end of day Tue Sep 30 PT.

Counts by group:
- New investor: 0 firms, 1 angel (Anton Bernstein, $25K. He signed the $25K SAFE on Sep 26, not the original $40K)
- In talks: 8 firms, 1 angel (Paul Heydon, $50K. He said yes but his DocuSign is still unsigned)
- Awaiting reply: 14 firms, 0 angels
- Keep warm: 2 firms (LVP, Hiro Capital), 0 angels

Total: 26 on the list (24 firms, 2 angels).

The 8 firms in talks are a16z, GFR, Dentsu Ventures, T-Accelerate, NCsoft, SciPlay, Homa and Brightwater Games Fund. Homa and Brightwater aren't on the 2025 list, but both had calls on my calendar and we pitched both the bridge. Per Arthur's tester log, only T-Accelerate and Dentsu have the internal builds (iOS and Android). The rest are marked "none".

LVP and Hiro both passed after we pitched them on a call. I've added them to a Keep warm checklist on the Existing Investor Update card.

A few that are off the sheet:
- Play Ventures: their no went to Griffin, with no call.
- Grishin, 1AM Gaming/March, Lakestar and Gorkem's fund: all said no with no call.
- Mattel: RFP only.
- Transcend and Acterra: only plans to reach out.
- Supercell and Laton: off-list with no call.
- Rollic, Metaplay and SVB: work-for-hire, engine company and bank.

a16z stays in talks because the speedrun rejection isn't their answer on the bridge.

See you Monday.

Fred
